mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces equity discount rates, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.5 percentage points over three months signals deteriorating labor market conditions and impending economic contraction, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: The joint occurrence of a low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) and high unemployment rate (above 5.0%) signals a coordinated policy response to economic distress, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% and UNRATE is above 5.0%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in housing starts below 1000 thousand units signals weakening consumer demand and impending economic slowdown, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when the regime is late-cycle expansion and HOUST is below 1000, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of industrial production (above 105) signals robust manufacturing activity and strong economic growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is above 105, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in real personal consumption expenditures exceeding 1.0% over three months signals weakening consumer demand and impending economic slowdown, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS falls > 1.0% in 3 months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: The joint occurrence of high inflation (CPIAUCSL above 240) and a high federal funds rate (above 1.5%) signals a restrictive monetary policy stance, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL is above 240 and FEDFUNDS is above 1.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production exceeding 2.0% over three months signals a contraction in manufacturing activity and impending economic slowdown, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO falls > 2.0% in 3 months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
